Thanks again for the call this morning, Jared — great to get visibility into where Novanova is headed on inference latency and data controls. Quick post-call recap and next steps so we can lock a short technical brief (30 minutes) with the right folks.

Recap (high level)
- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for live scoring, cut per-token cost on batch reranks, and ensure keys/PII never leave your VPC.
- Must-haves for the brief: ops/infra owner, platform lead (to validate deployment options), and a quick security checkbox on KMS/HSM + logging.

Proposed brief format (30 min)
- 20 min: product walkthrough (runtime, routing, caching, quantization recommendations)
- 10 min: Q&A + next-step alignment / mutual action plan

Please pick two windows that work for the cross-functional group below — I put times in ET (your timezone) and included a PST conversion for our calendar:
- Option A: Wed, Jun 18 — 11:00–11:30 AM ET / 8:00–8:30 AM PT
- Option B: Thu, Jun 19 — 3:00–3:30 PM ET / 12:00–12:30 PM PT
- Option C: Fri, Jun 20 — 9:00–9:30 AM ET / 6:00–6:30 AM PT

Who should be on the invite? If you can confirm ops/platform/security attendees (names + emails) for whichever slots you prefer, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short deck. I attached a 1-page technical brief and a mutual action plan template for planning.

Quick asks
- Pick two options (A/B/C)
- Confirm 2–3 attendees (ops/platform/security) and any special constraints (air-gapped environment, strict egress rules, SOC2 evidence needed)

Attaching: redwood-technical-brief.pdf (1p), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (template)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate invites once I have the preferred windows.

Best,
Mina Haddad
